name: 21701 · Frederick, MD
findings: ZIP 21701 (Frederick) has 253 nonprofit organizations. 129 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 103 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21701 (Frederick) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 21701 (Frederick) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 60 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
